metadata.geography: synthetic 9 demand nodes + 3 depot nodes (12 total), COORD_SCALE=0.12, ROAD_FACTOR=1.25
metadata.manualAlignment: manual version alignment 2026-10-15D, not live sync

demandLabel: completed-trip reference converted to test request input, not demand forecast
scopeNote: local sandbox, not national forecast; 500/36/5 is legacy rollout hypothesis, not calculated optimum
serviceCriteriaNote: Test acceptance criteria (fulfilment>=95%/99%, p95wait<=6/3min), NOT portfolio dispatch-success metric
objectiveFormula: mean(cashOPEX + annualDepreciation + annualStagingCost) across seeds, ranked lowest among feasible
demandRebalancingNote: No active demand rebalancing: requests are generated per demand mix and not redistributed based on fleet position. Demand is exogenous.
